draft.subject: Re: Checking in on Clearwater Media's setup
draft.body:
Hi Maya,

Glad it's feeling good so far, and thanks for the update. Adding the rest of the team is a nice next step: a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time if that's easier for a larger group.

If it's helpful, I'm happy to walk through getting your team added on a short call this week -- just tell me a time that works and I'll send an invite.

Best,
Priya
